name: Question coverage and sensitive restrictions
reason: 113 source items inventoried; 85 traced, 19 partial, 9 out of scope; 92 rows with 0 sourceVerified; seven windows replaced and 11 wording changes.

name: Branch coverage and distinct timeframes
reason: 14 declarative branches and an unconditional crisis question work; seven timeframe substitutions and orphaned branch details remain.

name: Answer integrity
reason: Answer states are distinct and blank becomes unresolved, but hidden children retain fields and the crisis flag is client-authored.

name: Review and explicit submission
reason: Client invalidation and required acknowledgement work, but the server accepts arbitrary acknowledgements and there is no submission idempotency.

name: Consent separation and withdrawal
reason: Marketing is off by default and required permissions are enforced, but consent evidence is client-asserted and revocation/suppression is unimplemented.

name: Recipient control
reason: Recipient is a server constant with an allowlist; a probe confirmed an injected recipient falls back and the email contains no health, name or DOB content. Not tested with a live provider.

name: Secure access
reason: Both migrations replay and 25 isolated RLS/RPC/immutability checks pass; live Supabase RLS is unverified and no policy or client check requires AAL2, so MFA enrollment is not enforcement.

name: Delivery reliability
reason: No idempotency, no retry claiming, duplicate-send and webhook-regression paths, no provider test, and confirmation copy can say 'queued' when nothing was sent.

name: Leak prevention
reason: No analytics, browser storage, URL answers or secret in the bundle; held sensitive source text is shown to customers, no retention/deletion control exists and live logs were unavailable.

name: Human review of consequential actions
reason: No automated eligibility, rate or carrier action; reviewer actions are logged and corrections are append-only. Live reviewer access not tested.
